title: Pipe
description:
Implement a `pipe` function that combines functions left-to-right. `pipe(f, g)(x)` is equivalent to `g(f(x))`.

**Example:**
```js
const double = x => x * 2;
const addOne = x => x + 1;
pipe(double, addOne)(3) // addOne(double(3)) = 7
```
ai_context: Pipe is the mirror of compose — it uses `reduce` (left-to-right) instead of `reduceRight`. Learners who mix them up will get the wrong execution order. The test for call order is a useful sanity check to verify direction without caring about the computed value.
